text: Lesson 1 established what Thornbury's leadership wants. This lesson turns that into a real build order — a six-stage pipeline where every stage's output is exactly what the next stage needs.

Real order data already sits in AdventureWorks2012. From there, this capstone builds a dw schema in T-SQL, then an automated Python validation layer, and only then opens Power BI, Tableau, and Excel. The warehouse gets built first, and proven correct, before any front-end tool is touched.

At the center of the warehouse sits dw.FactProductSales, with one row per order line. Around it sit four dimensions — DimProduct, with category and subcategory flattened directly onto it, plus DimDate, DimTerritory, and DimCustomer.
Next lesson locks the exact grain and keys for this schema, before a single CREATE TABLE statement gets written.
